author: Aly Moursy
text:
Today we're launching @VeezaAI (YC F26) - an AI tourist visa agent for people with weak passports.

Yes, you read that right. Weak passports.

If you have a US or EU passport, you book a flight and go. For the rest of the world, every trip starts with forms, bank statements, and fighting for an appointment.

We've suffered through this for 30 years. Those days are coming to an end.

Pick your destination. Veeza AI does the paperwork and books the appointment.

 start at: https://www.veeza.ai
source: Post text from the X API read on 2026-10-19 (exact text). Tool URL in the post is https://www.veeza.ai.
